name: Horrible Rattlesnake 14
author: ErzenXz
description: Outlined rounded gray text input that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes 2px solid #d3d3d3, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 20px -17px. On focus, border becomes 2px solid #808080.
html: <input placeholder="Searth the internet..." type="text" name="text" class="input">
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Horrible Rattlesnake 14</title>
<style>
/* Horrible Rattlesnake 14 by ErzenXz — https://uiverse.io/ErzenXz/horrible-rattlesnake-14 */
.input {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 220px;
  height: 45px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1.5px solid lightgrey;
  outline: none;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1);
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 20px -18px;
}

.input:hover {
  border: 2px solid lightgrey;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 20px -17px;
}

.input:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
}

.input:focus {
  border: 2px solid grey;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Searth the internet..." type="text" name="text" class="input">

</body>
</html>
